mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (book_id, document_type, reference_id, content, source_order_start, source_order_end, page_number_start, page_number_end, embedding, embedding_model, strategy_version) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{documentType}, #{referenceId}, #{content}, #{sourceOrderStart}, #{sourceOrderEnd}, #{pageNumberStart}, #{pageNumberEnd}, CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), #{embeddingModel}, #{strategyVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS document_id, source_order_start AS source_order, 1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) AS score FROM rag_document WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), id LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT paragraph.id, paragraph.source_order, page.page_number, paragraph.content FROM book_paragraph paragraph JOIN book_page page ON page.id = paragraph.page_id WHERE paragraph.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY paragraph.source_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_document WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{bookId}
